text:
Sam K: Quick thread — outreach + scheduling plan for the next DP cohort. Need sign-off on messaging, time options, and the mini-survey.
Maria P: 👍 can we add an async 15-min option? Many partners are in APAC and prefer async.
Sam K: Yes — propose three engagement options in outreach: 1) 30m live kickoff, 2) 15m live check-in, 3) async onboarding + recorded demo + short survey.
Jonah L: For scheduling: include timezone selector and preferred day-of-week. If they pick "async", auto-send kickoff packet.
Priya (PM): Draft outreach copy (short):

"Hi {name},
We're launching a small private beta for Redwood Private. We'd love to invite {company} to be a design partner — prioritized access, direct influence on product, and engineering support. If interested, pick a preferred time below or choose an async option and we'll send next steps. NDA + simple consent form included.
Cheers, Priya"

Maria P: Copy looks good. Add a single sentence on expected commitment: "~2 hrs total over 6 weeks: kickoff, 2 feedback checkpoints, optional follow-up." Clear expectations help conversion.
Sam K: Agreed. Also add compensation language: "$500 cloud credits or 3 months free Dedicated trial" — ask legal if phrasing OK.
Jonah L: Mini-survey draft (to send after async onboarding). Keep it 6 questions max. Example:
```
1) How easy was the onboarding? (1-5)
2) Were the integration docs sufficient? (yes/no)
3) Which workflows did you test? (short answer)
4) Any accuracy/regression concerns? (short answer)
5) Would you recommend participating in future pilots? (Y/N)
6) Preferred sync cadence? (weekly / biweekly / ad-hoc)
```
Priya (PM): Nice. Add a free-text prompt to capture feature asks and blockers. That's where product gets the gold.
Maria P: Scheduling logistics: avoid Calendly for security reasons. Use internal scheduling page + iCal invites. Also include an option to propose a time.
Sam K: For intake form, required fields: company name, contact, role, timezone, preferred sync format, NDA checkbox, short description of use-case, data sensitivity level (low/medium/high).
Jonah L: We should also capture success criteria per partner (what does success look like for them). Will feed prioritization and early metrics.
Priya (PM): Success metrics proposal for cohort:
- Target: 8–12 engaged DP orgs
- Activation: 75% complete onboarding within 2 weeks
- Feedback: average 2 actionable issues reported per org per two-week cycle
- Retention: 80% stay through pilot end
- Signal quality: at least 60% of partner-reported feedback labeled "product-impactful"

Sam K: Sounds reasonable — we'll mark NPS as optional since sample size small.
Maria P: Internal ops: assign 1 SE and 1 PM per 3 partners. Set weekly office hours for drop-in support in APAC/EU/US windows.
Jonah L: Can we automate follow-ups? Suggest sending survey reminders at +3 days and +7 days for async folks.
Sam K: Good. Add a 'grace' schedule to calendar invites: have auto-reschedule flows if kickoff not confirmed within 5 days.
DesignBot: Created event template "DP Kickoff — 30m" and uploaded calendar template to /assets/DP/templates :calendar:
Priya (PM): Legal/Consent: short consent checkbox + link to the non-disclosure PDF and a one-paragraph data handling note. Copy for legal review:
"By participating you agree to share non-sensitive examples for product improvement. Redwood will not use customer data for model training without explicit consent." 
Maria P: For higher-sensitivity partners, flag for Private offering with on-prem options and add extra SLA discussion.
Sam K: Outreach cadence: initial email -> two reminder emails over 10 days -> last outreach with an invite to an office-hour drop-in.
Jonah L: Tracking: add intake form responses to a spreadsheet with scoring columns: fit(1-5), urgency(1-5), data-sensitivity, timezone, legal green? Then sort top decile for fast follow-up.
Priya (PM): Scoring rubric idea: weight product-fit 40%, integration feasibility 25%, strategic value 20%, commit likelihood 15%.
Maria P: Can design team prepare a 3-slide template for partners to fill in use-case and success criteria? Makes kickoff focused.
Sam K: Yes — add to onboarding packet: slide template, API keys example, test prompt set, and integration checklist.
Jonah L: Final Q: rollout blockers? any concerns from infra or security?
Priya (PM): Infra: need a sandbox dataset and short-living creds. Security: NDA + ops checklist. I'll kick off requests after we lock message copy.
Sam K: Ok — next steps: Priya to finalize copy + intake form tonight; Maria to prepare async onboarding flow; Jonah to build scoring sheet; Sam to coordinate legal/comp details. We'll reconvene Friday 10:00 PT.
Maria P: 👍
Jonah L: 👍
Priya (PM): on it.
DesignBot: Reminder: "DP Kickoff — 30m" template scheduled for review on Friday 10:00 PT. :bell:
